subject: general
question: Kavita has deposited Rs. 4000 with the bank for two years at 6.25% simple interest per annum. What will be the total amount that Kavita will receive at the end of the two-year term?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 4000

Rate = 6.25%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SI = (P × R × T)/100
